title: Dasakam 21 – Nava varṣāḥ tathā saptadvīpāḥ | jambūdvīpādiṣu upāsanāpaddhatiḥ

stanzas.sanskrit:
मध्योद्भवे भुव इलावृतनाम्नि वर्षे
गौरीप्रधानवनिताजनमात्रभाजि ।
शर्वेण मन्त्रनुतिभिः सुमुपास्यमानं
सङ्कर्षणात्मकमधीश्वर संश्रये त्वाम् ॥ २१-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The earth's middle region is called Ilaavratam and is inhabited exclusively by women with Parvati where Lord Vishnu is worshipped as Sankarshana by Shiva.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
madhyodbhave bhuva ilāvṛtanāmni varṣe
gaurīpradhānavanitājanamātrabhāji |
śarveṇa mantranutibhiḥ sumupāsyamānaṃ
saṅkarṣaṇātmakamadhīśvara saṃśraye tvām || 21-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भद्राश्वनामक इलावृतपूर्ववर्षे
भद्रश्रवोभिरृषिभिः परिणूयमानम् ।
कल्पान्तगूढनिगमोद्धरणप्रवीणं
ध्यायामि देव हयशीर्षतनुं भवन्तम् ॥ २१-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhadraswam, east of Ilaavratam, is inhabited by Bhadrasrvas and they worship Lord in the form of Hayagreeva, who is the embodiment of Knowledge.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhadrāśvanāmaka ilāvṛtapūrvavarṣe
bhadraśravobhirṛṣibhiḥ pariṇūyamānam |
kalpāntagūḍhanigamoddharaṇapravīṇaṃ
dhyāyāmi deva hayaśīrṣatanuṃ bhavantam || 21-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
ध्यायामि दक्षिणगते हरिवर्षवर्षे
प्रह्लादमुख्यपुरुषैः परिषेव्यमाणम् ।
उत्तुङ्गशान्तधवलाकृतिमेकशुद्ध-
-ज्ञानप्रदं नरहरिं भगवन् भवन्तम् ॥ २१-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Harivarsham is to the south of Ilaavratam where Prahalada and other devotees pray to lord in Narahari form whose body is tall and white & calm.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
dhyāyāmi dakṣiṇagate harivarṣavarṣe
prahlādamukhyapuruṣaiḥ pariṣevyamāṇam |
uttuṅgaśāntadhavalākṛtimekaśuddha-
-jñānapradaṃ narahariṃ bhagavan bhavantam || 21-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
वर्षे प्रतीचि ललितात्मनि केतुमाले
लीलाविशेषललितस्मितशोभनाङ्गम् ।
लक्ष्म्या प्रजापतिसुतैश्च निषेव्यमाणं
तस्याः प्रियाय धृतकामतनुं भजे त्वाम् ॥ २१-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: To the west of Ilaavratam is the Ketumalam, where lord is in the form of Kamadeva and worshipped by Lakshmi and sons of Prajapathi.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
varṣe pratīci lalitātmani ketumāle
līlāviśeṣalalitasmitaśobhanāṅgam |
lakṣmyā prajāpatisutaiśca niṣevyamāṇaṃ
tasyāḥ priyāya dhṛtakāmatanuṃ bhaje tvām || 21-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
रम्ये ह्युदीचि खलु रम्यकनाम्नि वर्षे
तद्वर्षनाथमनुवर्यसपर्यमाणम् ।
भक्तैकवत्सलममत्सरहृत्सु भान्तं
मत्स्याकृतिं भुवननाथ भजे भवन्तम् ॥ २१-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Ramyakam which is to the north is the place where Vaivaswata Manu worships Lord in the form of fish or Matsya.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ramye hyudīci khalu ramyakanāmni varṣe
tadvarṣanāthamanuvaryasaparyamāṇam |
bhaktaikavatsalamamatsarahṛtsu bhāntaṃ
matsyākṛtiṃ bhuvananātha bhaje bhavantam || 21-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
वर्षं हिरण्मयसमाह्वयमौत्तराह-
-मासीनमद्रिधृतिकर्मठकामठाङ्गम् ।
संसेवते पितृगणप्रवरोऽर्यमा यं
तं त्वां भजामि भगवन् परचिन्मयात्मन् ॥ २१-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: To the north of Ramyakam is region Hiranmayam, where Lord resides in the form of huge Tortoise which bore the Mandara mountain on its back and worshipped by Chief of Pitrus, Aryama.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
varṣaṃ hiraṇmayasamāhvayamauttarāha-
-māsīnamadridhṛtikarmaṭhakāmaṭhāṅgam |
saṃsevate pitṛgaṇapravaro’ryamā yaṃ
taṃ tvāṃ bhajāmi bhagavan paracinmayātman || 21-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
किं चोत्तरेषु कुरुषु प्रियया धरण्या
संसेवितो महितमन्त्रनुतिप्रभेदैः ।
दंष्ट्राग्रघृष्टघनपृष्ठगरिष्ठवर्ष्मा
त्वं पाहि विज्ञनुत यज्ञवराहमूर्ते ॥ २१-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Goddess of Earth worships the Lord in the form of divine Varaha Moorthy who took the avataar to save the earth to the north of Hiranmayam named UthiraKuru.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kiṃ cottareṣu kuruṣu priyayā dharaṇyā
saṃsevito mahitamantranutiprabhedaiḥ |
daṃṣṭrāgraghṛṣṭaghanapṛṣṭhagariṣṭhavarṣmā
tvaṃ pāhi vijñanuta yajñavarāhamūrte || 21-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
याम्यां दिशं भजति किम्पुरुषाख्यवर्षे
संसेवितो हनुमता दृढभक्तिभाजा ।
सीताभिरामपरमाद्भुतरूपशाली
रामात्मकः परिलसन् परिपाहि विष्णो ॥ २१-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Kimpurusham, to the south of Ilaavratam is the place where Lord exists in the form of Rama and is worshipped by the mighty Hanuman with supreme devotion.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yāmyāṃ diśaṃ bhajati kimpuruṣākhyavarṣe
saṃsevito hanumatā dṛḍhabhaktibhājā |
sītābhirāmaparamādbhutarūpaśālī
rāmātmakaḥ parilasan paripāhi viṣṇo || 21-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
श्रीनारदेन सह भारतखण्डमुख्यै-
-स्त्वं साङ्ख्ययोगनुतिभिः समुपास्यमानः ।
आकल्पकालमिह साधुजनाभिरक्षी
नारायणो नरसखः परिपाहि भूमन् ॥ २१-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: In the bharathakandam region, Lord exists in the form of Narayana with his companion Nara and is worshipped by Sage Narada and other supreme devotees.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śrīnāradena saha bhāratakhaṇḍamukhyai-
-stvaṃ sāṅkhyayoganutibhiḥ samupāsyamānaḥ |
ākalpakālamiha sādhujanābhirakṣī
nārāyaṇo narasakhaḥ paripāhi bhūman || 21-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
प्लाक्षेऽर्करूपमयि शाल्मल इन्दुरूपं
द्वीपे भजन्ति कुशनामनि वह्निरूपम् ।
क्रौञ्चेऽम्बुरूपमथ वायुमयं च शाके
त्वां ब्रह्मरूपमयि पुष्करनाम्नि लोकाः ॥ २१-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
People worship Lord in the form of :
Sun in Plaksha dveepam
Moon in Shaalmala dveepam
Fire in Kushadveepam
Water in Krauncha dveepam
Wind in Shaakadveepam
Brahma in Pushkaradveepam
stanzas.stanza_roman:
plākṣe’rkarūpamayi śālmala indurūpaṃ
dvīpe bhajanti kuśanāmani vahnirūpam |
krauñce’mburūpamatha vāyumayaṃ ca śāke
tvāṃ brahmarūpamayi puṣkaranāmni lokāḥ || 21-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सर्वैर्ध्रुवादिभिरुडुप्रकरैर्ग्रहैश्च
पुच्छादिकेष्ववयवेष्वभिकल्प्यमानैः ।
त्वं शिंशुमारवपुषा महतामुपास्यः
सन्ध्यासु रुन्धि नरकं मम सिन्धुशायिन् ॥ २१-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Lord is worshipped in the form of Simsumara by great sages and stars such as Dhruva and planets.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sarvairdhruvādibhiruḍuprakarairgrahaiśca
pucchādikeṣvavayaveṣvabhikalpyamānaiḥ |
tvaṃ śiṃśumāravapuṣā mahatāmupāsyaḥ
sandhyāsu rundhi narakaṃ mama sindhuśāyin || 21-11 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
पातालमूलभुवि शेषतनुं भवन्तं
लोलैककुण्डलविराजिसहस्रशीर्षम् ।
नीलाम्बरं धृतहलं भुजगाङ्गनाभि-
-र्जुष्टं भजे हर गदान् गुरुगेहनाथ ॥ २१-१२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Narayana Bhattathiri worships Lord Guruvayoorappan in the form of Adhiseshan residing at Paataalalokam with thousand heads wearing blue dress with a plough in the hand as weapon and requests him to accept his praise and eradicate his ailments.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pātālamūlabhuvi śeṣatanuṃ bhavantaṃ
lolaikakuṇḍalavirājisahasraśīrṣam |
nīlāmbaraṃ dhṛtahalaṃ bhujagāṅganābhi-
-rjuṣṭaṃ bhaje hara gadān gurugehanātha || 21-12 ||
